after.lib/policies.ex:
defmodule Billing do
  @doc "Build a paid invoice. Tax applies to the subtotal."
  def complete(order) do
    Completion.run(order, trial: false, collect: true, include_tax: true)
  end
end
defmodule Trials do
  @doc "Activate a trial without collecting money. Its duration is in days."
  def activate(trial) do
    Completion.run(trial, trial: true, collect: false, include_tax: false)
  end
end
after.lib/completion.ex:
defmodule Completion do
  def run(data, opts) do
    result = if opts[:trial], do: %{kind: :trial, days: data.days}, else: %{kind: :invoice}
    result = if opts[:trial] do
      result
    else
      amount = if opts[:include_tax], do: data.subtotal + data.tax, else: data.subtotal
      Map.put(result, :total, amount)
    end
    Map.put(result, :paid, opts[:collect])
  end
end
